motion.name: auth-maroon-ribbons
motion.value: none; static SEC reference ribbon SVG image
motion.purpose: Local reference-derived auth-story artwork remains still for all motion preferences; no animation loop or timed rendering.

brand.preservation: Copied unchanged; retain proportions, contain fit, circular rounding, and no shrinking.

signIn.placement: Single logo in the story’s top brand; no duplicate logo above the form heading.

authStoryBackground.description: The user-pinned sign-in foundation is white (#ffffff) across the page, story, form region, and decorative background, retaining the desktop left/right split. Static maroon ribbon artwork uses broad, overlapping fabric curves from the SEC reference, served locally as `public/society-ribbon.svg`. Its source is `https://ragnarok-flame-iota.vercel.app/brand/sign-in-ribbon.svg`; the local adaptation uses a (720 × 900) viewBox with `translate(-250 0) scale(.9 1)` to fit the story region. A white readability veil preserves dark-ink headings and muted body copy; the brand remains maroon. The decoration is a static image, pointer-inert and hidden from assistive technology, with no animation or client rendering loop and no runtime external asset request. The compact mobile white brand header remains the mobile composition. The authenticated workspace continues the same white foundation, pale rules, and muted maroon focus outline. A right-edge mask (`linear-gradient(90deg, #000 82%, transparent 100%)`) softly fades the artwork into the white split instead of ending at a hard cutoff.

applicationReceipts.description: Application forms add a labeled confirmation-email field using the existing control style, with help text explaining the receipt destination and acceptance of an officer’s personal email. Receipt status is a normal paragraph (13px), with (16px 0 22px) margins and wrapping for long addresses; written messages distinguish queued, sent, and failed delivery while confirming that a failed email leaves the application saved. SEC review offers the existing secondary-button style to retry eligible unsent receipts, disabled while busy. These additions retain the ordinary form and record hierarchy.
applicationReceipts.fieldHelp: We’ll send a receipt here when you submit. An officer’s personal email is fine.
applicationReceipts.retryVisibility: Receipt exists, status is not SENT, and confirmation attempts are below 5.

dashboard.layoutDescription: The public navigation destination is Dashboard. SEC’s dashboard prioritizes the oldest five applications awaiting review with direct review actions and a full-queue link, then the earliest five upcoming or ongoing selected-semester events with event-management actions and explicit check-in or manual High Impact award status. It also shows up to five enabled societies without an active PRT credit in that semester and up to five enabled accounts awaiting setup across all semesters, with direct setup-link actions. Counts beside section headings reflect the full matching lists, and truncation text points to the complete destination. The full society points table remains available in the initially collapsed native disclosure, “All society point totals.” The society dashboard retains category totals, applications, and recent attendance, adding the next three upcoming or ongoing events and a View events link.
dashboard.rowDescription: Dashboard action rows reuse ruled records and existing primary, secondary, or text actions. Row content allows shrinking with `min-width: 0`, while its direct action does not shrink. At (760px) and below, action rows stack their content and action vertically, align to the start, and use an (8px) gap. The native points-register disclosure summary is maroon, (13px), weight (650), with (12px 0 20px) padding. Repeated direct actions have descriptive accessible names; changing navigation destinations scrolls to the top.

events.status: Check-in availability or manual SEC award for High Impact.

prtFollowUp.scope: Enabled societies without an active, nonrevoked PRT credit of at least one point in the selected semester

awaitingSetup.scope: Enabled, unactivated society accounts across all semesters

admin.counts: Full matching lists, independent of preview limits.

composition.description: Dashboard composition uses open sections separated by hairlines, with (26px 0) section padding and (24px 0) on mobile. The page headline is `clamp(34px, 3.5vw, 52px)` with (1.12) line height and (-0.04em) tracking, fixed at (34px) on mobile. Section headings are (19px), weight (650), reducing to (18px) on mobile; counts sit outside the heading in muted body type (14px, weight 500). Empty sections become one compact status line with a check icon and an optional destination action, using (18px 0) padding, without an extra heading or description. Each section keeps its accessible name and `data-count`. SEC has one primary header action: review the oldest pending application, otherwise manage the earliest upcoming event, otherwise create an event. The collapsed points-register content is also flat. This dashboard treatment adds no motion; the static login reference artwork remains unchanged.
composition.pointTrackers: Flat top and bottom rules, internal dividers, no corner radius.
primaryHeaderActionPriority: Review next application: oldest pending submission
Manage next event: earliest upcoming event

loginHelp.description: The login combines account setup and password-reset help in one pale rose card (#fcf5f5) with a (1px #ead4d8) border, the input-matching (6px) radius, (18px) padding, and a (32px minmax(0, 1fr)) grid with a (12px) gap. A maroon KeyRound icon (17px) sits in a white circular holder (32px). The bold title and body are (12px); body margins are (7px 0 10px). The “Contact an SEC chair” action is maroon (12px, weight 650), with an ArrowRight icon, (8px) gap, and (36px) minimum height; hover underlines the label. Its mail link targets `society@sec.tamu.edu` with subject “SocietyHub account help.” Story topic rows use ink (13px, weight 500), a (10px) flex gap, and maroon FileText, CalendarDays, and Users icons (17px). Autofilled sign-in inputs retain white fill with a (1000px) inset white shadow, ink text and text fill, and a maroon caret through `:is(:autofill, :-webkit-autofill)`.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Main action with maroon hover and explicit disabled treatment.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:11px 17px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; background:var(--maroon,#500000); color:#ffffff; font:650 12px/1.4 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); min-height:42px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#712727; box-shadow:0 3px 8px #50000016; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus,#8c4658); outline-offset:4px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Supporting action with a ruled paper surface.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:11px 17px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; background:var(--maroon,#500000); color:#ffffff; font:650 12px/1.4 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); min-height:42px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#712727; box-shadow:0 3px 8px #50000016; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus,#8c4658); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-secondary { background:var(--paper,#fff); color:var(--ink,#292623); border-color:var(--line,#e5e2df); } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--tint,#f7f2f3); box-shadow:none; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Persistent label with a white bordered control and mobile-readable type.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:7px; color:var(--ink,#292623); font:600 12px/1.6 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); } .ds-input { padding:11px 12px; min-height:43px; border:1px solid #cec8ca; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink,#292623); font:400 13px/1.6 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); caret-color:var(--maroon,#500000); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted,#68645f); } .ds-input:disabled { background:#f6f4f5; color:var(--muted,#68645f); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus,#8c4658); outline-offset:4px; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-input { font-size:16px; } }

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: White workspace navigation with muted resting text and a transparent maroon active state marked by a thin left rule.
components.css: .ds-nav { padding:18px; background:var(--paper,#fff); border-right:1px solid var(--line,#e5e2df); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; } .ds-nav-item { padding:12px 14px; min-height:46px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:#68645f; font:400 13px/1.6 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:not(.ds-active):hover { background:var(--tint,#f7f2f3); color:var(--maroon,#500000); } .ds-active { position:relative; background:transparent; color:var(--maroon,#500000); font-weight:650; border-radius:6px; } .ds-active::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:12px; bottom:12px; width:2px; background:var(--maroon,#500000); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus,#8c4658); outline-offset:4px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {  .ds-nav-item { transition:none; } }

components.name: Positive status pill
components.description: Compact written state reinforced by semantic green.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:5px 9px; border-radius:5px; background:var(--green-bg,#eaf3ed); color:var(--green,#265c43); font:650 10px/1.5 var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); white-space:nowrap; }

components.css: .ds-tracker { padding:24px 26px; background:var(--paper,#fff); color:var(--ink,#292623); font-family:var(--sans,"DM Sans Variable",sans-serif); } .ds-category { font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-total { margin:15px 0 20px; font:750 44px/1.2 var(--heading,"Manrope Variable",sans-serif); letter-spacing:-.04em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-unit { font-size:12px; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:0; color:var(--muted,#68645f); } .ds-progress { display:block; width:100%; height:5px; accent-color:var(--green,#265c43); border:0; border-radius:3px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--tint,#f7f2f3); } .ds-progress::-webkit-progress-bar { background:var(--tint,#f7f2f3); } .ds-progress::-webkit-progress-value { background:var(--green,#265c43); } .ds-positive { font-size:11px; margin:10px 0 0; color:var(--green,#265c43); }

narrative.overview: White surfaces, maroon identity and actions, calm headings, and ruled records give societies and SEC a shared operating workspace. Readable records, explicit status, and efficient forms set the visual density. The public name is SocietyHub. Use the existing SEC circular logo copied unchanged from Delphi/public/sec_favicon.png; Nexus is an internal name only.
keyCharacteristics: Unified white surfaces with maroon identity and pale rose states.
Compact, readable records with clear hierarchy and tabular totals.
Restrained motion and explicit interaction states.

rules.name: The Status Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a written status; it never replaces the status label.

dos: Do use white surfaces, pale rose interaction states, and thin rules for operational records.
Do retain labels, category names, and tabular totals when showing status or points.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep closed mobile navigation out of keyboard navigation.
donts: Don't replace written states with color alone.
Don't apply resting shadows to the flat record panels.
Don't substitute an invented mark for the supplied SEC logo.
